name: open-contribute
description: Agent Skills that take a developer from "I want to contribute to open source" to a submitted pull request, measuring whether a repo actually merges outside PRs before recommending anything.

plugins.name: first-contribution
plugins.description: Find a repo that actually merges outside PRs, an issue that is genuinely open, and go through the fix to a submitted pull request. Filters repos on availability, gates them on whether external PRs land, and triages every candidate issue against an 8-step checklist ending in whether the defect still exists in current code. Includes an English and a Korean variant, plus a RAG-specific flow.
